en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic view over a small valley town surrounded by wooded hills. In the center stands a church with a tower and clock, bordered by tightly packed townhouses along a curving main street. In the foreground, on a hillside behind a wooden fence, a man in dark formal clothing and hat leans against a tree looking over the town. At the top of the image, printed in red, is the caption 'Glashütte i. Sa,'.
